items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Yes, yeah, he's our manager now. He leads the band.

ctx.x: Does Albert lead the band now?

Yes, yeah, he's our manager now. He leads the band. Yeah, he's doing a pretty good job at it. Keeping things going pretty good. Yeah, we've got a few jobs coming up. We're playing Saturday at the Fairgrounds. Which one of the guys was that? Racetrack on? Yes, uh-huh. I met you. It's a night dance. We usually play here in the deer when they have the horse show. Yeah. But this is something going on, some kind of dance going on Saturday night. We're playing from 8 to 12. Oh, yeah. We went to Pensacola Saturday past.…
How do you travel now, Brian?
